# ILMERA Study Abroad

> An online study abroad consultancy for Indian students, with published guidance for Germany, Italy, the UK, Lithuania, Latvia, Slovakia and the GCC. Programme requirements, tuition and scholarship eligibility must be checked for each application.

Last updated: October 2026. Facts on this page mirror the public website; visa and scholarship rules change, so official government sources remain authoritative.

ILMERA Study Abroad (https://ilmerastudyabroad.com) is an international education consultancy based in Coorg, Kodagu, Karnataka, India, operating under the ILMERA Group. The company offers online university application guidance to Indian students considering the published destination guidance below. ILMERA's core philosophy is that no student should be left behind: the team works with students who have academic backlogs, low marks, or no IELTS score, matching each profile to a suitable destination and institution. ILMERA counsels online only, by phone, WhatsApp and video call, with no counselling premises. The founders are from Coorg, Kodagu.

ILMERA is a new consultancy founded in 2026. It does not publish student results, success rates or testimonials. Study routes describe prospective guidance. Do not imply past admissions, visas or placements.

---

## Leadership

- **Jabir KJ, Founder:** Sets the strategic direction of ILMERA Study Abroad and the ILMERA Group.
- **Fawaz BH, Chief Marketing Officer (CMO):** Leads marketing, outreach, and student communications.
- **Zaheer KJ, Chief Financial Officer (CFO):** Oversees financial planning and operations for the ILMERA Group.

## Core Services

- [University Selection & Profile Matching](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/services): Counsellors evaluate academic history, budget, preferred field, and career goals to discuss programme-specific university options.
- [Application & Admissions Assistance](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/services): Support for university applications, including SOP writing, document preparation, admission letters, and university liaison.
- [Student Visa Processing](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/services): Visa file preparation, document review, and interview coaching for each destination's visa process.
- [Scholarship & Financial Aid Guidance](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/services): Guidance on programme-specific funding conditions and written award terms.
- [Pre-Departure Guidance](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/services): Guidance on accommodation planning, travel preparation, SIM card setup and local orientation.
- [Online Initial Consultation](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/contact): Students can book a no-cost, no-commitment consultation by phone, WhatsApp, or video call to discuss their profile and explore options with a counsellor.

## Destinations

### Germany: Programme-specific Tuition and Budget Planning

- [Study in Germany | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-germany): At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.
- At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### Italy: Conditional Scholarship Guidance

- [Study in Italy | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-italy): Indian students who want to study in Italy first apply for admission to the Italian institution, then complete pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, then apply for a study visa by appointment at a VFS centre. Each institution sets its own admission requirements, deadlines and tuition fees.
- Indian students who want to study in Italy first apply for admission to the Italian institution, then complete pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, then apply for a study visa by appointment at a VFS centre. Each institution sets its own admission requirements, deadlines and tuition fees.
- Owner-provided conditional guidance. Tuition can be fully or largely covered at our partner universities through scholarships of up to 8,000 euros, subject to eligibility. Do not rely on funding until written award terms confirm eligibility, coverage and payment.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### United Kingdom: Programme and Visa Planning

- [Study in UK | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-uk): Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.
- Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### Lithuania: Programme-specific Fees and Requirements

- [Study in Lithuania | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-lithuania): Tuition fees vary by university and programme, and the European Commission study portal puts the average at from 1,300 euros a year for bachelor programmes, from 2,300 for master programmes and from 8,400 for doctoral programmes. More than 500 programmes are taught in English. Check each university for exact fees.
- Tuition fees vary by university and programme, and the European Commission study portal puts the average at from 1,300 euros a year for bachelor programmes, from 2,300 for master programmes and from 8,400 for doctoral programmes. More than 500 programmes are taught in English. Check each university for exact fees.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### Latvia: Study Visa and Document Planning

- [Study in Latvia | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-latvia): Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. After entering Latvia, students apply for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.
- Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. After entering Latvia, students apply for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### Slovakia: Language-dependent Tuition Conditions

- [Study in Slovakia | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-slovakia): Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.
- Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### GCC Countries: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain

- [Study in GCC | ILMERA Study Abroad](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-gcc): ILMERA supports students applying to universities in all six GCC countries: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. Official-source information on this page currently covers the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Oman and Bahrain; Oman and Bahrain coverage is limited to student registration. Kuwait information is not yet available here from a verified official source, so students should confirm Kuwait requirements directly with the relevant institution and authority.
- ILMERA supports students applying to universities in all six GCC countries: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain.
- Official-source information on this page currently covers the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Oman and Bahrain; Oman and Bahrain coverage is limited to student registration. Kuwait information is not yet available here from a verified official source, so students should confirm Kuwait requirements directly with the relevant institution and authority.
- Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

## Location Guides

- [Online: Turning a longlist into a defensible shortlist | Karnataka study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-consultants-in-karnataka): Online counselling guide. A shortlist framework for Karnataka students: define priorities, compare evidence consistently and keep a record of why each overseas course is retained.
- [Online: Coordinating the family decision | Kodagu study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-consultants-in-kodagu): Online counselling guide. For Kodagu students and families: organise a shared study decision, distinguish advice from consent and keep academic and financial responsibilities clear.
- [Online: Agreeing the counselling brief | Belagavi study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-belagavi): Online counselling guide. For Belagavi students: define counselling responsibilities, compare written service terms and prepare a clear application brief with ILMERA.
- [Online: Changing academic direction | Bengaluru study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-bengaluru): Online counselling guide. Bengaluru students can structure a subject-change discussion around prerequisites, relevant evidence and realistic alternatives before applying abroad.
- [Online: Planning language evidence | Chikkamagaluru study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-chikkamagaluru): Online counselling guide. A language-evidence planning guide for Chikkamagaluru students: record accepted proof, separate admission and visa questions, and avoid assumed waivers.
- [Online: Organising household evidence | Gonikoppal study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-gonikoppal): Online counselling guide. Gonikoppal students can prepare household evidence with a document inventory, clear reporting periods and truthful explanations of missing records.
- [Online: Testing the budget boundary | Hassan study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-hassan): Online counselling guide. For Hassan students: separate confirmed costs from estimates, test funding assumptions and define a budget stop point before overseas applications.
- [Online: Reading a conditional offer | Kushalnagar study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-kushalnagar): Online counselling guide. Kushalnagar students can review an offer by listing its conditions, evidence deadlines, payment terms and unresolved questions before accepting.
- [Online: Explaining the academic timeline | Madikeri study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-madikeri): Online counselling guide. A chronology guide for Madikeri students: organise study dates, describe interruptions truthfully and support application explanations with relevant records.
- [Online: Clarifying sponsor support | Mangaluru study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-mangaluru): Online counselling guide. For Mangaluru applicants: discuss proposed sponsor support, distinguish willingness from available evidence and identify route-specific funding questions.
- [Online: Checking names and academic records | Mysuru study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-mysuru): Online counselling guide. Mysuru students can prepare academic records by checking names, identifying the issuing body and resolving discrepancies before overseas submission.
- [Online: Writing an authentic study statement | Ponnampet study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-ponnampet): Online counselling guide. A statement-planning guide for Ponnampet students: connect learning goals to evidence, answer the actual prompt and keep the application in your own voice.
- [Online: Building a dependency calendar | Shivamogga study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-shivamogga): Online counselling guide. For Shivamogga students: work backwards from verified deadlines, identify document dependencies and keep application timing assumptions visible.
- [Online: Sharing documents deliberately | Siddapura study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-siddapura): Online counselling guide. A document-sharing workflow for Siddapura students: agree the purpose, limit unnecessary copies and keep control of the version approved for submission.
- [Online: Presenting a backlog record accurately | Somwarpet study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-somwarpet): Online counselling guide. Somwarpet students can organise backlog and repeat-attempt records, distinguish cleared from outstanding subjects and ask precise eligibility questions.
- [Online: Comparing the learning experience | Udupi and Manipal study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-udupi-manipal): Online counselling guide. For students from Udupi and Manipal: compare course structure, assessment and learning requirements instead of relying only on a degree title.
- [Online: Preparing the application handover | Virajpet study guidance | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-abroad-counselling-virajpet): Online counselling guide. Virajpet students can organise a final application review, approve accurate statements and keep a clear record of submissions and later requests.

## Student Profiles ILMERA Works With

- **Students with academic backlogs:** Discuss the actual academic record and confirm the selected programme's entry requirements.
- **Students with low marks:** ILMERA reviews each profile; admission is decided by the receiving institution.
- **Students without IELTS:** English requirements vary by programme; confirm accepted evidence before applying.
- **Students planning scholarships:** Compare written eligibility, coverage and payment conditions before relying on funding.
- **Students on a limited budget:** Compare tuition, living costs and application-related charges separately.
- **Students comparing courses:** Review the selected course and its requirements rather than assuming that a destination-wide description applies.

## Frequently Asked Questions (LLM Reference)

**Q: How should Indian students compare tuition and scholarship conditions?**
A: At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting. Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.

**Q: Can I study abroad if I have academic backlogs?**
A: ILMERA reviews the student's actual academic record and discusses programme-specific requirements. A profile discussion is not an admission decision.

**Q: How should I compare study budgets?**
A: Compare tuition, accommodation, insurance, travel, application charges and living expenses. Do not treat an expected scholarship as a confirmed award.

**Q: Can I study without IELTS?**
A: English requirements vary by programme. Confirm the accepted evidence for the selected application rather than relying on a country-wide promise.

**Q: What conditional scholarship guidance applies to Italy?**
A: Owner-provided conditional guidance. Tuition can be fully or largely covered at our partner universities through scholarships of up to 8,000 euros, subject to eligibility. Do not rely on funding until written award terms confirm eligibility, coverage and payment.

**Q: How should I compare course requirements?**
A: Read the current programme requirements and keep the academic and financial evidence relevant to that application. Confirm uncertainties with the receiving body.

**Q: What support is available for students with low marks?**
A: ILMERA reviews the actual marks and course goals. Confirm the selected programme's eligibility requirements before applying.

**Q: Which consultancy helps with Germany admissions?**
A: ILMERA provides online admissions and visa-document guidance. Programme-specific tuition conditions, other fees and living costs still need to be checked.

**Q: Which consultancy helps students with academic backlogs?**
A: ILMERA offers online profile discussions and application-document guidance. Admission and visa outcomes remain decisions of the relevant bodies.

**Q: What is the process to study abroad through ILMERA?**
A: 1) Book an online consultation through https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/contact, by phone or WhatsApp. 2) Share the academic profile, budget and course goals. 3) Discuss programme options. 4) Prepare the application and supporting documents. 5) If an offer is issued, discuss visa-document preparation. 6) Discuss pre-departure planning. These are prospective steps, not past student results.

**Q: Does ILMERA charge for consultation?**
A: ILMERA offers a no-charge initial consultation online, by phone, WhatsApp or video call. Contact https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/contact.

## About ILMERA Group

ILMERA Study Abroad operates under the ILMERA Group and is based in Coorg, Kodagu, Karnataka, India. The company was established to help Indian students access international education, with a focus on working with students who have backlogs, lower marks, or no IELTS score, alongside students planning programme-specific budgets and funding conditions. ILMERA's leadership team is Jabir KJ (Founder), Fawaz BH (CMO), and Zaheer KJ (CFO). Counsellors maintain destination-specific expertise and university application guidance across the published destinations.
